verdict.rationale: PayPal is a payments platform/API, not an AI agent or assistant host that end-users configure with pluggable MCP servers to gain new tool capabilities. The evidence instead shows the reverse relationship — PayPal exposes its own MCP server and an Agent Toolkit so other agent frameworks can call PayPal's APIs — which is a different axis (PayPal as MCP server provider), not PayPal consuming external MCP servers as a client.
